purpose: Independent live verification of every active Hotspawn CS2 fixture and of the picks the published site shows, with dated source links; plus the exact limitations for the fixtures that still have no verified pick.

method.pipeline_run: The production pipeline (scripts.collect -> scripts.originate --live -> scripts.coverage_probe --live -> scripts.twc_research -> scripts.build -> scripts.audit_rows --strict) was executed on branch arena/11be2015 by .github/workflows/11be2015-live.yml. The sandbox itself has no route to the source hosts.
method.snapshot_committed: data/research/11be2015/live/ holds the snapshot summary, latest.json, origination.json, sources.json, row-source-audit.json and coverage-probe.json. The 32 MB of raw provider payloads those records replay from are not copied into the repository; the pipeline's own originals are published with the site under /data/evidence/ and /data/origination/evidence/ on every refresh, and the recorded request manifest in sources.json names each one.
method.build_result: PASS: 75 source rows reconciled; every published probability and pick replayed from first-party evidence. Row-source audit: 535 rows, 521 with an official link, 5 flagged unverified, 9 site-map, 0 without a source. 671 internal links checked.
method.independent_reads: Direct fetches of the Hotspawn fixtures API, the rendered Hotspawn lobby and match pages, HLTV event pages, Polymarket's CS2 board and EGamersWorld match pages were made with the assistant's web reader and are cited per observation. Nothing below is inferred from Hotspawn '% picked' or HLTV fan votes.
method.limitation: The assistant's reader can return a cached copy of a page. Every timestamp used below was therefore re-read on a cache-busted URL (?cb=...) or comes from the committed runner snapshot.

published_snapshot_check.verdict: The public site serves the 21 Oct 2026 20:08Z snapshot. An earlier uncache-busted read returned the 15 Oct 2026 snapshot; re-reading with a unique query string returned the current one, so that earlier read was a reader cache artifact and NOT a stale deployment. The production run 39666468012 (2026-10-21T20:08Z) recorded the same inventory and a 0-violation row audit.
published_snapshot_check.pages_mode: GitHub Pages for this repository is a legacy build from the main branch root (GET /repos/.../pages -> build_type legacy, source main /). scripts/publication records that the workflow waits for the legacy build and then publishes the verified artifact; the API refuses any change to the Pages build type (403 Resource not accessible by integration), so the setting cannot be corrected from this session.

benched_gods_titanflow.decision: No probability, no pick. A blank with a published reason is the only defensible output; EGamersWorld's 1.8/1.8 is not a price.
